title: Lesson 37 - Surfacing Data 360 Data in Other Systems: Enrichments, Related Lists, Data Cloud Objects, and APIs
description: Explain how to reference Data 360 data from other systems., focused on the paths that bring Data 360 data into other systems: enrichments and related lists on CRM records, Data Cloud objects used in CRM and flows, and the APIs for external access.

questions.question: A contact record must show every email engagement from across the enterprise. Which reference path fits?
options: A related list enrichment on a DMO with a one-to-many relationship to the unified individual
The Profile API on an engagement object
questions.explanation: A related list enrichment displays a DMO with a one-to-many relationship to the Individual or Unified Individual, which is exactly many email engagements, while copy fields need a one-to-one link, the Profile API excludes engagement objects, and a layout shows only org fields.

questions.question: A flow must read a pre-calculated, materialized view of related Data 360 data. What is the correct mechanism?
options: Add the data graph to the flow through its invocable action
Call the Profile API from the flow
questions.explanation: A data graph is a materialized view that can be accessed through an invocable action in a flow, while the Profile API serves external profile queries, copy fields display single values, and identity resolution is unrelated.

questions.question: An external app needs to run Data 360 SQL across unified and engagement data model objects. Which API fits?
options: The Profile API, because it covers engagement objects
The Query API, which runs Data 360 SQL and supports data streams, profile, engagement, and unified objects
questions.explanation: The Query API runs Data 360 SQL through the Data 360 Connect REST API and Apex and supports streams, profile, engagement, and unified objects, while the Profile API excludes engagement objects and enrichments and data action targets do not run ad hoc SQL.
